# Code of conduct

Be respectful, constructive and welcoming. Critique ideas and code without personal attacks. Harassment, discrimination, threats, sharing private information without consent and deliberate disruption are unacceptable.

Maintainers may edit or remove content, close discussions, or restrict participation to protect the community. Report incidents privately to @Firebird55 through an available GitHub private contact channel; for vulnerabilities use Security → Report a vulnerability. Do not publish personal details while requesting a contact channel.
